title: codebase-mapping and its rustc-wrapper answer say the rustc -vV spawn fails only when the outermost wrapper is unresolvable
goal: kb/public/agents/codebase-mapping.md's DER fact on the wrappers in front of rustc -vV (line 92) and the conclusion of QK-unresolvable-rustc-wrapper-rustc-workspace-wrapper in kb/public/_answers.md say the spawn fails only for an unresolvable outermost wrapper: with a valid RUSTC_WRAPPER and an unresolvable RUSTC_WORKSPACE_WRAPPER only rustc_fingerprint fails and the cache turns off, while Cargo's spawn succeeds. run: import pathlib,sys; ls=pathlib.Path('kb/public/agents/codebase-mapping.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()+pathlib.Path('kb/public/_answers.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines(); sys.exit(any(('the spawn of that command fails too' in l or 'the same wrapper then fails the spawn' in l) for l in ls))
